name: labs/helixworks-technologies__helixcycler
title: HelixCycler OT thermocycler (tc_send_code.HardwareController)
intro: HelixCycler OT thermocycler (tc_send_code.HardwareController), adapted from helixworks-technologies/helixcycler. It reads `lid_temperature`, `plate_temperature` and `plate_hold_remaining`; sets `lid_setpoint`, `plate_setpoint` and `shake_speed`; runs `set_plate_target`, `open_lid`, `close_lid` and `deactivate_all`. `set_plate_target`: set the target temperature of a thermal zone and optionally wait for the zone to reach the setpoint within a declared tolerance. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
